name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets.

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: Based on this visibility and the opportunities we are pursuing, we expect the group order inflows to grow in the range of 10% to 12% in FY27.
items.actual: Up 14% year on year in Q1 FY27
items.why: Q1 order inflows grew 14%, and management said in July it remained on track for the range.
items.actual_quote: Reflecting this momentum, the group order inflows at Rs. 1,080 billion, registered a 14% Y-on-Y growth.

items.quote: On Revenue, we expect growth to be in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
items.why: Filed results show first-half revenue of Rs 1,46,692 crore, up 11.4% on Rs 1,31,663 crore a year earlier, inside the range.

guidance.note: No transcript of the October 2026 call is on file, so H1 revenue comes from the filed quarterly results.

bull.text: Management is delivering: 2 of 2 checkable promises kept or on track
Revenue has compounded 16% a year over 5 years

bear.text: Profit lagged sales (8% vs 16% a year), so margins compressed

items.quote: Reflecting these factors, the group revenues for Q1 FY '27 stood at Rs. 679 billion, registering a 7% Y-on-Y growth, with international revenues accounting for 51% of the total group revenues.

claims.summary: The one company-wide figure management read out on the last 2 calls matches the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years only 85% of reported profit came in as operating cash. Some profit is tied up in inventory or receivables.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 77 days to pay, against 89 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 21% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. A meaningful slice of profit does not come from the core business.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 7% while operating profit grew 5%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 23%, against 27% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 1.24× equity, against 1.36× two years earlier.

quality.summary: 5 of 7 checks are clean; look at: profit turns into cash, profit comes from the core business.
